entries.title: II Corinthians 12:1
segments: I must needs glory, though it is not expedient; but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:2
segments: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I know not; or whether out of the body, I know not; God knoweth), such a one caught up even to the third heaven.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:3
segments: And I know such a man (whether in the body, or apart from the body, I know not; God knoweth),

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:4
segments: how that he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:5
segments: On behalf of such a one will I glory: but on mine own behalf I will not glory, save in [my] weaknesses.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:6
segments: For if I should desire to glory, I shall not be foolish; for I shall speak the truth: but I forbear, lest any man should account of me above that which he seeth me [to be], or heareth from me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:7
segments: And by reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted overmuch, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, that I should not be exalted overmuch.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:8
segments: Concerning this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:9
segments: And he hath said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for [my] power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:10
segments: Wherefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:11
segments: I am become foolish: ye compelled me; for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing was I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I am nothing.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:12
segments: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, by signs and wonders and mighty works.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:13
segments: For what is there wherein ye were made inferior to the rest of the churches, except [it be] that I myself was not a burden to you? forgive me this wrong.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:14
segments: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a burden to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:15
segments: And I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:16
segments: But be it so, I did not myself burden you; but, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:17
segments: Did I take advantage of you by any one of them whom I have sent unto you?

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:18
segments: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? walked we not in the same spirit? [walked we] not in the same steps?

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:19
segments: Ye think all this time that we are excusing ourselves unto you. In the sight of God speak we in Christ. But all things, beloved, [are] for your edifying.

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:20
segments: For I fear, lest by any means, when I come, I should find you not such as I would, and should myself be found of you such as ye would not; lest by any means [there should be] strife, jealousy, wraths, factions, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults;

entries.title: II Corinthians 12:21
segments: lest again when I come my God should humble me before you, and I should mourn for many of them that have sinned heretofore, and repented not of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they committed.
